import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='transaction_type', data=df, ci=None)
plt.title('Transaction Amount by Hour and Type')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Amount ($)')
plt.legend(title='Transaction Type')
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
